lessons.title: Auxiliary haber and hay
lessons.objective: Auxiliary haber and hay: Hay means there is / there are.
lessons.explanation:
Hay means there is / there are. Auxiliary haber combines with an invariant participle: he comido. Existential hay is not the same paradigm as auxiliary he / has / ha.
